transcript.text: Hi everyone. I've got one portable PA system available for informal lending this weekend. Marco, I understand you're interested in using it for a neighborhood performance at the park. Before I make any decision, I'll need you to state your proposed terms for the loan, and I'll also need the park steward to share any site requirements I should know about. Go ahead whenever you're ready.

transcript.text: I'd like to propose borrowing the PA system on Sunday from 14:00 to 17:00, returning it by 18:00. In exchange, I'd offer you two 60-minute beginner vocal-coaching lessons.
